_about: Three-scene test of the local ComfyUI pipeline: AI portrait + AI battlefield + animated map, cut to the opening of the approved Ep02 narration (already paid; no new credits).

groups: He rose from an artillery officer
to become the most feared / ruler in Europe.
and his empire / reshaped the continent.
only to find much of the city / burning.
and bitter cold / devastated his forces.
At Waterloo, / his army was defeated.
This time, exile meant / a remote island in the Atlantic:
the consequences / of his own ambition.

beats.cue: He rose from an artillery officer

illustration.framing: cinematic close-up portrait, head and shoulders, three-quarter view facing right, both eyes clearly visible, face in the upper third of the frame, one gloved hand resting on a sword hilt near the lower edge
illustration.scene: Napoleon Bonaparte as a young general around 1804, calm determined gaze toward the horizon, wind lifting his hair and coat collar, blurred tricolour flags and soldiers far behind

illustration.framing: epic wide battlefield panorama, horizon slightly above the middle of the frame, columns of French line infantry advancing from the lower foreground toward distant hills, several tall tricolour flags with golden eagles, cannon smoke drifting across the field
illustration.scene: battle of Austerlitz, 2 December 1805, morning fog lifting from the valley, Pratzen heights in the distance, cavalry on the flank, drummers, no single hero figure
illustration.lighting: low winter sun breaking through the fog from the right, golden rim light on smoke and flags, cool blue-grey shadows, apricot sky
illustration.negative_extra: close-up, portrait, modern uniforms, rifles with scopes, helmets
